title: Instant Book Share and the Host Service Fee Percentage (Host Accounts)
content:
# Host Fees Policy — Instant Book Discount on a Re-Rated Percentage (Host Accounts)

When a Host Accounts holder's host service fee is re-rated, an Instant Book discount comes off the re-rated percentage according to the share of the account's listed and snoozed Listings that have Instant Book on:

| Share of listed and snoozed listings with Instant Book on | Instant Book discount |
|---|---|
| At least 75% | 0.20 percentage points |
| At least 50% but fewer than 75% | 0.10 percentage points |
| Fewer than 50% | None |

The discount comes off the percentage the re-rating starts from, once, and is taken off before the re-rated fee is worked out. Listings in any other status (for example unlisted, suspended, removed or draft) are counted neither in the share nor in the total.

## Cases (hypothetical portfolios of 20 listed and snoozed listings)

| Listings with Instant Book on | Share | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| 15 | 75% | 0.20 points |
| 14 | 70% | 0.10 points |
| 10 | 50% | 0.10 points |
| 9 | 45% | None |
